cardHold.description: Place an authorization hold on an account for the amount.

params.name: account
params.description: The account to place the hold on.

params.name: settlementAccount
params.description: The settlement account to use.

params.name: journal
params.description: The journal to post transactions to.

params.name: amount
params.description: The decimal amount of the hold.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency of the hold amount.

params.name: direction
params.description: CREDIT or DEBIT direction of hold. Usually DEBIT.

params.name: correlation
params.description: Correlation identifier to group related transactions.

params.name: effective
params.description: Effective date for the transaction.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Effective date for the transaction.

entries.description: 'Card hold placed on account in parameters.'
